item.title: Snapshot in Time: Old Victoria District Hospital pictured in 1930s shows building remains mostly unchanged
item.description: This view captured nearly 100 years ago on a Postcard Series shows the glorious old Victoria District Hospital on Chapman Road.

item.title: Geraldton Grammar School hosts special 30th anniversary event for past, present students, staff, families
item.description: The community past and present that has shaped Geraldton Grammar School came together last weekend to mark its 30th anniversary.

item.title: Consumer Watch with Candice Evans: What to know to avoid missing the boat on new seafood labelling rules
item.description: Australian seafood lovers are used to seeing country of origin labels when shopping, with this requirement applying to most food for retail sale for almost a decade.

item.title: Geraldton artists will open their doors in September thanks to $33,000 in State Government funding
item.description: A Geraldton arts organisation has received a significant funding commitment to support an immersive event later this year.

item.title: Edith Cowan Statue will be unveiled at the end of February opposite Geraldton Courthouse
item.description: The statue of one of Geraldton’s most famous women is set to be unveiled on Wednesday February 25, after facing transport issues that have delayed the arrival from December.

item.title: Women on Wheels returning next month in Geraldton with long table lunch, entertainment to celebrate
item.description: Women on Wheels is coming back around for another year next month, with a new format and new route promising to offer more entertainment than ever before.

item.title: Geraldton Softball Association round 14: Cooper Jefferies stars as Suiside secures minor premiership
item.description: Suiside’s men’s division one side set the tone for round 14 in emphatic fashion, cementing top spot on the ladder with two dominant wins over Rams and Batavia Blaze.

item.title: Geraldton Waterpolo Association round 15: B52s book direct ticket to women’s A-grade grand final
item.description: B52’s secured the women’s A-grade minor premiership in the final round of the Geraldton water polo season, defeating Demons 8-3 on Saturday afternoon and booking a direct passage through to the grand final.

item.title: State Government invests $8.7m to unlock council-owned land in Mahomets Flats for up to 140 key-worker homes
item.description: The State Government is investing more than $8 million to unlock a Geraldton coastal superblock in a bid to see it developed for up to 140 key-worker homes.

item.title: Price hiked on some flights as discounted travel for regional residents released for second half of year
item.description: Discounted fares for regional travel have been released for the second half of the year, with Mid West residents now able to book capped flights for travel after June 30.
